name: AH Realty Trust, Inc.
description: AH Realty Trust Inc is a real estate investment trust (REIT). It owns, operates, and acquires high-quality properties across the Mid-Atlantic and Southeast, creating lasting value for investors, partners, clients, tenants, and communities. The group focuses on operating and acquiring high-quality, well-positioned assets with growth potential and delivering long-term value for shareholders. Its portfolio includes Harbor Point, Southern Post, The Interlock, and Others.
